Pearson Virtual Schools says it can help build a full-time online school and that Connections Academy schools include curriculum, teachers, a learning platform, and required services to run a K-12 public school.
Connections Academy is described by Pearson as a tuition-free online public school model, and Pearson states that Connections Academy schools are K-12 virtual learning programs.

Scholastic reported that Education Solutions revenue faced pressure from the supplemental curriculum market, indicating direct sensitivity to school and district curriculum spending cycles.

node: K-12 virtual schooling and alternative digital schooling platforms
summary: Expanded the universe around the chokepoint of operating compliant multi-state K-12 virtual schools. The reference lane is Stride as the clearest public pure-play and Pearson as a large-cap competitor through Connections Academy/Pearson Virtual Schools. The underfollowed lane points to second-order vendors that may benefit from the operational constraints of virtual schools: Scholastic as a sub-$1B K-12 instructional-materials and digital-content supplier, and RCM Technologies as a speculative below-$300M special-education, therapy, nursing, and telepractice staffing provider for school districts. Key bottleneck variables to verify next are state authorization exposure, enrollment/funding sensitivity, district contract durability, special-education compliance capacity, and whether curriculum/staffing vendors have named virtual-school customers.
